title: A constant second difference: n² + 2n − 1
caption: The first differences 5, 7, 9, 11 rise by 2 each time. A constant second difference of 2 means the sequence is quadratic with 2 ÷ 2 = 1 n²: the nth term is n² + 2n − 1.
alt: Five boxes 2, 7, 14, 23, 34; first differences +5, +7, +9, +11 beneath; second differences +2, +2, +2 beneath those.
description: Second differences: 2 each time, so the n² coefficient is 1.
